title: 伊斯特伯里**克里斯蒂娜·伍德：韩国市场股息策略，企业改革带来机会
speaker: Christina Wood

segments.en: So given the potential inflation backdrop, what else are you looking at potentially dividend yielding in this environment?
segments.zh: 那么在潜在通胀背景下，您还在关注哪些可能带来股息收益的资产？

segments.en: Yeah, I would say actually going back to Korea, some of the stocks there still have quite a strong dividend angle because what we've seen over the past few years in terms of corporate reform is one that's multi-year.
segments.zh: 是的，回到韩国市场，一些权益资产仍有很强的股息吸引力，因为过去几年我们看到的企业改革是多年期的。

segments.en: So we're still seeing some of these companies come up with dividend policies that are improving.
segments.zh: 所以我们仍看到一些公司推出改善的股息政策。

segments.en: So your payout ratios go up year-on-year or they're improving how they look at shelter return, whether it's based off of cash flows as well.
segments.zh: 因此，派息率逐年上升，或者他们改善了对股东回报的考量，包括基于现金流等。

segments.en: So that's a rhetoric that I would say actually support some of or any of the fraud that comes out of the Korean market too.
segments.zh: 所以我认为这种说法实际上也支持了韩国市场的一些或任何欺诈行为。

segments.en: So that's something that could be interesting.
